compiled_state.title: validate-review-output.sh: empty findings:[] + valid summary -> SCHEMA_VALID pass (no review-completed attestation; fail-open)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Deferred Review Nitpick (panel-discovered)

### Expected
A clean review must be distinguishable from a garbled/truncated/stripped reviewer payload that happens to retain findings:[] + a summary. Passing the gate should require a positive review-completed signal, not merely 'findings is a list'.

### Actual
validate-review-output.sh treats an empty findings:[] (with a >=10-char summary) as SCHEMA_VALID: yes -> clean review -> merge. There is no 'non-empty findings OR explicit no-issues attestation' requirement. The 588e panel (security lens) flagged this as a live fail-open: a malformed/garbled reviewer response degraded to {findings:[], summary} would pass as a clean review and merge un-reviewed code. Orthogonal to 284b (fallback_hops). Fix direction: require a positive, non-synthetic review-completed marker distinct from finding-presence. Ref: panel ticket 0734-6880-76be-425e.

comments.body: This bug IS the panel's O5-C2 requirement (positive review-completed attestation): empty findings:[] must not pass validation as a clean review. Single source of truth — do not double-track. Parented under 588e; gates 3ee4 (enforce-flip) — under enforce a fail-open lets un-reviewed code reach main (SC1/SC2).

comments.body: INVESTIGATION COMPLETE (INTERMEDIATE, opus). ROOT CAUSE (high conf, empirically confirmed): validate_code_review_dispatch() in validate-review-output.sh accepts {findings:[], summary>=10chars} as SCHEMA_VALID — no positive review-completed marker. The 2-key migration (commit 1752a4c4de, story 6c75-cc5d) removed the incidental scores-presence guard without a replacement, so a garbled/stripped empty payload is byte-equivalent to a genuine no-issues review. Defect at lines 305-319 (required_top={findings,summary}) + 443-448 (summary>=10 is the only completeness check). Confirmed: {findings:[],summary:'All checks passed cleanly.'} -> SCHEMA_VALID exit 0. No existing field carries the signal (review_tier optional/post-injected; reviewer_hash downstream). PRECEDENT: the synthetic-type exemption (parse_error/specialist_error/fallback_exhausted, lines 356-364) already uses a positive 'type' field to distinguish a real infra-empty from garbage — Fix A generalizes this. TWO FIXES: (A) new REQUIRED positive attestation field for empty-findings, emitted by all ~12 code-reviewer-*.md agents [strongest, O5-C2-faithful, fails closed; HIGH blast radius: validator + ~12 agents + contract docs in lockstep; trips COMPLEX 'agent+script' trigger]; (B) require a structured no-issues token inside the existing summary on the empty branch [lighter: validator + agent guidance, preserves 2-key contract; WEAKER — token in free-text, spoofable, arguably 'synthetic']. Both ORTHOGONAL to 284b (fallback_hops). Both need agent guidance changes. Awaiting user approval on approach (Phase D: safeguard modification + competing fixes require explicit approval).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FIX APPROVED (user, Fix A via SHARED BASE). Approach: add top-level 'review_completed' (bool) attestation. Validator (validate-review-output.sh): add review_completed to allowed_top; ENFORCE review_completed===true when findings==[] AND not a synthetic-type payload (non-empty findings already validated per-finding; synthetic infra-empties exempt via existing 'type' channel). Emit-side: reviewer-base.md output contract instructs all reviewers to always emit review_completed:true; regenerate agents via build-review-agents.sh (NOT hand-edit the 12 generated code-reviewer-*.md). Contract docs + tests updated. Complexity: MODERATE (single logical field via shared base; user explicitly approved this scope). testing_mode=RED (new behavior) + UPDATE existing empty-findings test cases. ORTHOGONAL to 284b. Dispatching opus fix sub-agent under strict RED->GREEN.
